locate_source_function: locate the source file path and line number of a given Python function
locate_source_callable: locate the source code location of a callable object including its class
locate_source_partial: locate the source of a functools.partial wrapped function and extract partial args
create_SourceLocation_namedtuple: create a SourceLocation named tuple with name, file path, line number, and partial args
get_qualified_name_object: get the fully qualified module and class name of a Python object
